_comment: Human-signed policy for slang-perf-analyst. Bundled default; an operator-mounted policy/PERF_POLICY.json wins over it (same mechanism as the PR approver's APPROVAL_POLICY.json). Every ledger line records the policy_version it was decided under. Only a human widens this: `mode` in particular is never changed by the agent.

reporting.note: Reply to the bot's Compile-perf nightly message in nvr-slang-dev whose run URL exactly matches this run. Applies in every mode, including shadow. Never post at channel root or select an unrelated thread.

mode_values.shadow: Decide and record what WOULD be filed; file nothing. Compare the ledger with what humans did.
mode_values.approval: A human approves each filing through an approval card before anything is created.
mode_values.live: File without a human gate, within the caps below.

known_flaky.api_module_graph|apiGetCode: bimodal: about 21 ms normally, with isolated samples near 31 ms on 4 of the 7 nights from 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-06; a rerun whose five samples all land in the slow mode is not by itself a regression

accidental.meaning: cost unrelated to the PR's purpose

avoidable-overhead.meaning: the functionality is needed but the implementation cost can shrink

inherent.meaning: cost scales with the new functionality, or the PR acknowledged it; record as an accepted delta

unclear.meaning: intent or mechanism could not be established; internal report only

measurement.note: If the A/A spread on this host exceeds aa_max_spread_pct, wall-clock attribution is not trustworthy here: use instruction counts if available, otherwise the class is `unclear`.

trust.note: The analysis reads merged PRs only. Comments, reviews and linked-issue bodies are read only from the PR's author and these GitHub author_association values; anything else is counted and withheld, because anyone can comment on a merged PR.
